firstPass.queueInterpretation: historical derived-label queue; prioritize previously unrecorded live REVE labels and stop after deterministic first-pass decision

decisions.label: AJUNTAMENT DE CALVIÀ
decisions.model: official municipal direct tariff from 2026-02-02: 0.25 EUR/kWh; occupancy charge 3 EUR per hour or fraction after 4 free hours
decisions.coverageKnown: REVE snapshot: partyId CAL, 25 locations/EVSE/connectors. Municipality states the charging tariff applies to municipally owned stations and is paid through MELIB 2025.
decisions.resumeCondition: Reopen only on a municipal tariff change or evidence of station exceptions.
